span.p:
/chat turn]
Chat --> Router[Routing model
schedule_task · manage_tasks
decided with every other tool]
Router -->|schedule_task| Save[ConversationService
_apply_task_action]
Router -->|manage_tasks| Save
Locality[(Primary locality
timezone)] --> Save
Save -->|which task they mean| Picker[Routing model
pick_task]
Save --> Tasks[(scheduled_tasks
instruction encrypted · cadence · next_run_at)]
Save --> Outcome[task_outcome context
+ reply/task_outcome block]
Outcome --> Reply[Reply model
words the confirmation]
Reply --> Person
Loop[Discovery worker process
task loop] -->|enqueue due slots| Tasks
Tasks --> Runs[(scheduled_task_runs
one per slot · leased claim)]
Runs -->|claim| Runner[TaskRunner]
Runner -->|bearer as the person
task conversation · scheduled_task mark| Fire[/chat turn
+ reply/scheduled_task block
